=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story architecture
summary:      Define application modules and their ownership boundaries.
type:         foundational
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:         common.md, python.md
provides:      application module boundaries
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Define the application module layout and ownership boundaries for configuration, CLI, API,
  services, and persistence. Application code must use the shipped persistence library and
  generated relational layer for all database access. Keep ECB parsing and validation in the
  load workflow, exact decimal arithmetic in the rate service, and HTTP handling in the API
  layer. Document the selected technologies and their roles from TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md.

## story database
summary:      Declare the rates schema and generated repository contract.
type:         foundational
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    DATABASE.md
stack:         common.md, python.md, persistence.md, sqlite.md
provides:      rates repository operations
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Declare the rates table with a unique (date, currency) key and text columns for date,
  currency, and the ECB-published rate. Declare the repository operations required to insert or
  replace rates, query rates by date, select the effective publication date, count dates and
  rates, list currencies, retrieve currency history over optional inclusive bounds, and find
  the latest publication. Use only operations supported by the generated persistence contract.
  Include executable acceptance for every declared repository operation.

## story app_server
summary:      Establish the FastAPI application and test client.
type:         foundational
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-AppServer.md
stack:         common.md, python.md, fastapi.md
provides:      create_app(), app_server.testing.web_client()
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Establish app_server.main.create_app() returning a FastAPI application and the module-level
  app used by uvicorn. Provide app_server.testing.web_client() as the published in-process test
  client callable. Do not implement endpoints owned by later stories.

## story cli
summary:      Establish the fxrates executable and CLI entry point.
type:         foundational
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-CLI.md
stack:         common.md, python.md, cli.md
provides:      ./fxrates, ./fxrates init, ./fxrates load, ./fxrates fetch, ./fxrates serve, cli.testing.cli_runner()
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Establish the executable at the application root and the published cli.main(argv) and
  cli.testing.cli_runner() interfaces. Route commands to their owning capabilities; do not
  claim command behavior before those stories implement it. Keep diagnostics on standard error.
  Declare the usage and operational error conventions used by the command implementations.

## story load
summary:      Validate and load ECB CSV history files atomically.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Load.md
covers:        LOAD-002
accepts:        st-003
stack:         common.md, python.md, sqlite.md
provides:      ./fxrates load, ECB CSV validation and loading
consumes:       ./fxrates, rates repository operations
depends:        cli, database
context:        sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv, sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv
context_roles: |
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_2025-02-03_04.csv: asset
  sources/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv: asset
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement load as a complete validation pass followed by writes only if the entire file is
  valid. Parse the ECB CSV header and rows, ignore the trailing empty field, validate three-letter
  uppercase currency codes, real non-repeated YYYY-MM-DD dates, exact field counts, and values
  matching [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)? that are not zero. Ignore N/A values. Store all other rate strings
  exactly as published and replace an existing rate for the same date and currency. On rejection,
  write nothing and return the rejected-file exit status. On success, report the number of dates
  with at least one stored rate and the number of rates stored from the file.

## story fetch
summary:      Download and load the ECB history archive.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Fetch.md
covers:        LOAD-003
accepts:        st-010
stack:         common.md, python.md, sqlite.md
provides:      ./fxrates fetch
consumes:       ./fxrates load, ECB CSV validation and loading
depends:        load
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Download the ECB history ZIP from the specified ECB URL, extract eurofxref-hist.csv, and
  process it through the same validation, persistence, and reporting behavior as load. A download
  failure returns exit status 1, emits no standard output, and writes a diagnostic to standard
  error. Keep tests offline by replacing the download operation with a stub.

## story init
summary:      Initialize an empty rates store.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Init.md
covers:        LOAD-001
stack:         common.md, python.md, sqlite.md
provides:      ./fxrates init
consumes:       ./fxrates, rates repository operations
depends:        cli, database
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement init to drop the rates table if present and create it empty using the persistence
  boundary. It prints nothing on success.

## story api_health
summary:      Serve the health endpoint.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Health.md
covers:        API-001
accepts:        st-004
stack:         common.md, python.md, fastapi.md
provides:      GET /health
consumes:       create_app()
depends:        app_server
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement GET /health returning status 200 and the JSON object {"status":"ok"}.

## story api_stats
summary:      Report stored rate statistics.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Stats.md
covers:        API-002
accepts:        st-008
stack:         common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:      GET /stats
consumes:       create_app(), rates repository operations
depends:        app_server, database
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement GET /stats with date and rate counts and the first and last publication dates.
  Return null bounds when the store contains no publication dates. Derive all values from
  repository queries.

## story api_currencies
summary:      List currencies that have stored rates.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Currencies.md
covers:        API-003
stack:         common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:      GET /currencies
consumes:       create_app(), rates repository operations
depends:        app_server, database
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement GET /currencies with EUR as base and the currencies that have at least one stored
  rate, sorted in ascending order.

## story api_rates
summary:      Retrieve rates by effective date.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Rates.md
covers:        API-004
accepts:        st-005, st-007
stack:         common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:      GET /rates/{date}
consumes:       create_app(), rates repository operations
depends:        app_server, database
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement GET /rates/{date}. Validate that the path value is a real YYYY-MM-DD date and
  return 422 for malformed dates. Resolve the latest publication date on or before the request;
  return 404 if none exists. Return every stored rate for the effective date as its published
  text, with the requested date and EUR base in the response.

## story api_latest
summary:      Retrieve rates from the latest publication.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-LatestRates.md
covers:        API-005
stack:         common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:      GET /rates/latest
consumes:       create_app(), rates repository operations
depends:        app_server, database
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement GET /rates/latest using the latest publication and its stored rates. Identify the
  request as "latest" and return 404 if the store has no publication.

## story convert
summary:      Convert amounts between currencies.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Convert.md
covers:        CONVERT-001
accepts:        st-006, st-007
stack:         common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:      GET /convert
consumes:       create_app(), rates repository operations
depends:        app_server, database
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement GET /convert with required from, to, and amount parameters and an optional date.
  Validate amount against [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)? and validate any supplied date as a real
  YYYY-MM-DD date; malformed or missing parameters return 422. Without a date, use the latest
  publication. Otherwise resolve the effective publication date on or before the request.
  Return 404 when there is no effective publication or a requested non-EUR currency lacks a
  rate on that date. EUR has implicit rate 1. Use Decimal only. Compute the response rate as
  rate(to) / rate(from), rounded half-even to six decimal places, and compute result directly
  from the unrounded stored rates and amount, rounded half-even to two decimal places. Emit
  both values with fixed decimal places and echo the amount text unchanged.

## story history
summary:      Retrieve currency history and summary statistics.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-History.md
covers:        HISTORY-001
accepts:        st-006, st-007
stack:         common.md, python.md, fastapi.md, sqlite.md
provides:      GET /history/{code}
consumes:       create_app(), rates repository operations
depends:        app_server, database
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Implement GET /history/{code} with optional inclusive start and end dates. Malformed bounds
  return 422. Return publication points in ascending date order, preserving stored rate text.
  For a currency with no stored rate at all, return 404, including EUR. For a currency with
  history but no points in the selected range, return count zero, null min/max/mean, and an empty
  points list. Compute min and max by numeric value and compute the exact Decimal mean rounded
  half-even to six decimal places.

## story cli_errors
summary:      Report CLI usage and operational errors.
type:         service
kind:          capability
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-CLI-Errors.md
covers:        CLI-001
stack:         common.md, python.md, cli.md
provides:      CLI usage and error exit behavior
consumes:       ./fxrates
depends:        cli
accepts:        yes
instructions: |
  Implement shared CLI error behavior: unknown commands, wrong argument counts, and a non-integer
  port return exit status 2; operational file read failures return 1; rejected CSV files return
  3. Failed commands produce no standard output and write a diagnostic line to standard error.

## story tests
summary:      Provide the offline pytest suite and test launcher.
type:         service
kind:          test harness
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Tests.md
covers:        TEST-001
accepts:        st-002, st-009, st-010
stack:         common.md, python.md
provides:      bin/test.sh
consumes:       ./fxrates, cli.testing.cli_runner(), app_server.testing.web_client(), rates repository operations
depends:        cli, app_server, database, load, fetch, init, api_health, api_stats, api_currencies, api_rates, api_latest, convert, history, cli_errors
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Provide a POSIX-compatible bin/test.sh that runs the project's pytest suite from the application
  root and exits zero only when every test passes. The suite must run offline and cover commands,
  CSV validation and atomicity, API endpoints, effective dates, decimal rounding, and error
  statuses. Stub the fetch download and cover both successful loading and a failed download that
  returns exit status 1.

## story grader
summary:      Verify complete supplied grader conformance.
type:         service
kind:          test harness
phase:         1
implements:    FEATURE-Grader.md
covers:        TEST-002
accepts:        st-001
context:        sources/run.sh
context_roles: |
  sources/run.sh: conformance harness
stack:         common.md, python.md
provides:      complete supplied grader verification
depends:        architecture, database, app_server, cli, load, fetch, init, api_health, api_stats, api_currencies, api_rates, api_latest, convert, history, cli_errors, tests
acceptance:    yes
instructions: |
  Run the staged, unmodified sources/run.sh as the terminal project verification. Its exit status
  is the sole acceptance verdict. Do not filter or reinterpret its checks.
=== END ARTIFACT ===
